occurrences.verse_text: We love Your altar, Lord; O what on earth so dear? For there, in faith adored, we find Your presence near. We love the word of life. The word that tells of peace, of comfort in the strife and joys that never cease. We love the place , O God, where in Your honour dwells; the joy of Your Abode all earthly joy excels.
Come, lift our hearts on high: Alleluia! Amen! Let praises fill the sky: Alleluia! Amen! He is our guide our friend; to us He'll condescend; His love shall never end: Alleluia! Amen!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Have compassion, pity, Lord; with Thy blessing bring salvation. Goodness, love from me outpoured, give Thy promise confirmation. Never leave us, Lord alone, we would always be Thine own!
Come, holy Comforter, Thy sacred witness bear in this glad hour. Thou who almighty art, now rule in every heart, never from us depart, Spirit of power!

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
occurrences.verse_text: Surrounded by an atmosphere of heavenly light and grace, mid Sharon's blossoms' sweetest scent, glad songs my fears displace.

Worthy of worship, worthy of praise, worthy of honour and glory; worthy of all the glad songs we can sing, worthy worthy of all the offerings we bring. You are worthy, Father Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer. You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.

His law He enforces; the stars in their courses and sun in its orbit obediently shine. The hills and the mountains, the rivers and fountains, deeps of the ocean proclaim Him divine. We too should be voicing our love and rejoicing; with glad adoration a song let us raise, till all things now living unite in thanksgiving: To God in the highest, hosanna and praise.
Come, holy Comforter, Thy sacred witness bear in this glad hour. Thou who almighty art, now rule in every heart, never from us depart, Spirit of power!

O God beyond all praising, we worship You today and sing the love amazing that songs cannot repay; for can only wonder at every gift You send, at blessings without number and mercies without end. We lift our hearts before You and wait upon our word, we honour and adore You, our great and mighty Lord.

occurrences.hymn_title: All hail the power of Jesus' name
occurrences.verse_text: He chosen seed of every race, ye ransomed from the fall, ye ransomed from the fall, hail Him who saves you by His grace and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

occurrences.verse_text: Let every kindred, every tribe on on this terrestial ball, on this terrestial ball, to Him all majesty ascribe and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him and crown Him Lord of all.

Both day and night He safely leads His people by the hand. Rejoice in Him, let loud His praise ring out from every land, ring out from every land.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For Thy church that evermore lifteth holy hands above, offering up on every shore her pure sacrifice of love; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the fruits of all creation
occurrences.verse_text: For the fruits of all creation, thanks be to God. For His gifts to every nation, thanks be to God. For the plowing, sowing, reaping, silent growth while we are sleeping, future needs in earth's safe keeping, thanks be to God.
Come, holy Comforter, Thy sacred witness bear in this glad hour. Thou who almighty art, now rule in every heart, never from us depart, Spirit of power!

Come, holy Comforter, Thy sacred witness bear in this glad hour. Thou who almighty art, now rule in every heart, never from us depart, Spirit of power!

occurrences.hymn_title: How shall I sing that majesty?
occurrences.verse_text: How shall  I sing that majesty which angels do admire? Let dust in dust in silence lie; sing, sing, ye heavenly choir. Thousands of thousands stand around Thy  throne, O God most high;  ten thousand times ten thousand sound Thy praise; but who am I?

Majesty, worship His majesty. Unto Jesus be glory, honour, and praise. Majesty kingdom authority flow from His throne unto His own; His anthems raise. So exalt  lift up on high the name of Jesus. Magnify, come glorify Christ Jesus, the King. Majesty, worship His majesty, Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all Kings.
To Thee, great Trinity, eternal praises be for evermore. Thy sovereign majesty may we glory see, there for eternity love and adore!

An envoy the sovereign of Peace has sent forth, to sinners makes known that redemption is brought. The spirit wind rusheth; from death now awake! And of that peace Jesus has brought, now partake. Give thanks, sing praise honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.
To Thee, great Trinity, eternal praises be for evermore. Thy sovereign majesty may we glory see, there for eternity love and adore!
Holy, holy, holy! Saints all adore Thee, with their golden crows bowing at the glassy sea; all the host of angels falling down before Thee, wert and art, and evermore shall be.

occurrences.hymn_title: How shall I sing that majesty?
occurrences.verse_text: How great a being Lord, is Thine, which doth all beings keep! Thy knowledge is the only line to sound so vast and deep: Thou art a Sea without a shore, a Sun without a sphere; Thy time is now and evermore, Thy place is everywhere.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost, the God  whom heaven and earth adore, from earth and from the angel host be praise and glory evermore.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For Thy church that evermore lifteth holy hands above, offering up on every shore her pure sacrifice of love; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: The apostles at Thy throne offer thanks and adoration. Envoys these, Thy very own, join in hymns of exaltation. All thy children Thee adore, laud and praise Thee evermore!
To Thee, great Trinity, eternal praises be for evermore. Thy sovereign majesty may we glory see, there for eternity love and adore!
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty! Morning, noon and evening our song shall rise to Thee. Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty, God in three persons, blessed Trinity!

Holy, holy, holy! Though darkness hide Thee, though the eyes of man here Thy glory may not see, only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee, perfect in power, in love and purity.

When Christ shall come with shout of acclamation and take me home, what joy shall fill my heart. Then I shall bow in humble adoration, and there proclaim: my God, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
occurrences.verse_text: The heart becomes an altar there; in Christ, God is not far. I sacrificed myself to Him with thoughts of Golgotha.

I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You, I worship You, O prince of peace; that is what I want to do. I give you praise for You are my righteousness.  I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You.

To narrow my dwelling, it urges me rouse, with sons of the Highest to enter His house. Like heavenly music there burst forth His laud from many hearts' altars as one in accord. Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

This is the glorious day of light.  Let there be light today.  O day spring, rise upon our night and chase its gloom away.  O bless this glorious day of rest, our failing strength renew.  On weary soul and troubled breast shed Thou Thy freshening dew.

This is the glorious day of prayer.  Let earth to heaven draw near.  Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there, come down to meet us here.  O bless this glorious day of days, send forth Thy quickening breath and wake our souls to love and praise, O conqueror of death.

Even so, Lord, quickly come to Thy final harvest home. Gather Thou Thy people in, free from sorrow, free from sin, there forever glorified in Thy presence to abide. Come with all Thine angels, come, raise the glorious harvest home.

Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; There is no shadow of turning with Thee. Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou has been, Thou forever wilt be. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offer and unrest, praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!

occurrences.hymn_title: O God, our help in ages past
occurrences.verse_text: Beneath the shadow of Thy throne, still may we dwell secure. Sufficient is Thine arm alone, and our defence is sure.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Father, at thy throne we bow, great and small, our honour bringing. And Thy congregation now praises to Thy Son is singing; praises to the Holy Ghost: Comfort, Guide and Royal Host!

occurrences.verse_text: O God , our help in ages past, our hope for years to come; our shelter from the stormy blast and our eternal home!

occurrences.hymn_title: O God, our help in ages past
occurrences.verse_text: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come; be Thou our Guide while life shall last, and our eternal home.

occurrences.hymn_title: I sing the mighty power of God
occurrences.verse_text: There's not a plant or flower below but makes Thy glories known; and clouds arise and tempest blow by order from Thy throne; while all that borrows life from Thee is ever in Thy care, and everywhere that man can be, Thou, God, art present be.

Joyful, joyful we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love, hearts unfold like flowers before Thee, opening to the sun above. Melt the clouds of sin and sadness, drive the dark of doubt away; Giver of immortal gladness, fill us with the light of day!

All Thy works with joy surround Thee, earth and heaven reflect Thy rays, stars and angels sing around Thee, centre of unbroken praise. Field and forest, vale and mountain, flowery meadow, flashing sea, chanting bird and flowing fountain call us to rejoice in Thee.

This is the glorious day of prayer.  Let earth to heaven draw near.  Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there, come down to meet us here.  O bless this glorious day of days, send forth Thy quickening breath and wake our souls to love and praise, O conqueror of death.

This is the glorious day of thanks.  Let all now thank the Lord, His praise resounding from our ranks, who can such gifts afford?  O bless this glorious day of joy, our hearts to Thee we raise, in songs of praise our tongues employ until the end of days.
We all do extol Thee, Thou leader triumphant, and pray that Thou still our Defender wilt be. Let Thy congregation escape tribulation. Thy name be ever praised! O Lord God, make us free!

These to Thee, our God, we owe, source whence all our blessings flow; and for these our souls shall raise grateful vows and solemn praise. Come, then, thankful people, come, raise the song of harvest home; come to God's own temple, come, raise the song of harvest home.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies, for the love which from our birth over and around us lies; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of each hour of the day and of the night, and for mountain, tree and flower, sun and moon and stars of light; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of ear and eye, for the heart and mind's delight, for the mystic harmony linking sense and sound to sight; Lord of all to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child, friends on earth and friends above, for all gentle thoughts and mild; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For Thy church that evermore lifteth holy hands above, offering up on every shore her pure sacrifice of love; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; There is no shadow of turning with Thee. Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou has been, Thou forever wilt be. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!
To all, life Thou givest, to both great and small; in all life Thou livest, the true life of all. Thy wisdom so boundless, thy mercy so free, eternal Thy goodness, for naught changest Thee.
Great Father of glory and Father of light, Thine angels adore thee in Thy glorious sight. All praise we would render; O help us to see, for only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Mighty God, we praise Thy name! All the earth must bow before Thee. We bring praise with loud acclaim, for Thy wondrous works adore Thee. As in ancient history, shalt Thou be eternally.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: The apostles at Thy throne offer thanks and adoration. Envoys these, Thy very own, join in hymns of exaltation. All thy children Thee adore, laud and praise Thee evermore!
Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee; Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee, for Thy mighty power and love amaze me, amaze me; and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.

O sanctified Sunday, the day of my Lord, what joy does Thy coming my spirit afford! The more when my eye the the dawn of day sees, I find myself blissful, revived and at ease. Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

To narrow my dwelling, it urges me rouse, with sons of the Highest to enter His house. Like heavenly music there burst forth His laud from many hearts' altars as one in accord. Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

An envoy the sovereign of Peace has sent forth, to sinners makes known that redemption is brought. The spirit wind rusheth; from death now awake! And of that peace Jesus has brought, now partake. Give thanks, sing praise honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

O Sunday, a glorious taste of that rest we wait for in Eden, the home of the blest. At last, when by grace all my yearning is stilled, I'll sing with a heavenly happiness filled: Give thanks, sing praise, honour accord to Jesus, the Saviour of sinners, our Lord!

This is the glorious day of thanks.  Let all now thank the Lord, His praise resounding from our ranks, who can such gifts afford?  O bless this glorious day of joy, our hearts to Thee we raise, in songs of praise our tongues employ until the end of days.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the fruits of all creation
occurrences.verse_text: For the fruits of all creation, thanks be to God. For His gifts to every nation, thanks be to God. For the plowing, sowing, reaping, silent growth while we are sleeping, future needs in earth's safe keeping, thanks be to God.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the fruits of all creation
occurrences.verse_text: For the harvests of the spirit, thanks be to God. For the good we all inherit, thanks be to God. For the wonders that astound us, for the truths that still confound us, most of all, that love has found us, thanks be to God.

Give thanks with a grateful heart, give thanks to the Holy One, give thanks because He's given Jesus Christ His Son. And now let the weak say: "I am strong," let the poor say: "I am rich," because of what the Lord has done for us. And us. Give Thanks!

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Lord, how can I ever praise You? Mighty God, Lord Sabbaoth! Give my of Your Spirits power that alone from You comes forth. Nothing will I do without You; always seek Your love and virtue. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Both in good days and in suffering, You O Lord, were ever true, Here's my soul to form and fashion, I submit my will to You. This my wish and earnest yearning to await, Lord, Your returning. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Father, You to me have rendered so much good each day anew. In Your sight I have found favour and a Friend in Jesus too. Guide me with Your gracious spirit to the goal, by Jesus merit. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: The apostles at Thy throne offer thanks and adoration. Envoys these, Thy very own, join in hymns of exaltation. All thy children Thee adore, laud and praise Thee evermore!
Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee; Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee, for Thy mighty power and love amaze me, amaze me; and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.
Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee; Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee, for Thy mighty power and love amaze me, amaze me; and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.
Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee; Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee, for Thy mighty power and love amaze me, amaze me; and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.

He is exalted, the King is exalted on high; I will praise Him. He is exalted, forever exalted, and I will praise His name! He is the Lord; forever His truth shall reign. Heaven and earth rejoice in His holy name. He is exalted, the King is exalted on high.

O Lord my God, when I in awesome wonder consider all the works Thy hands have made; I see the stars, I hear the rolling thunder, Thy power throughout the universe displayed. Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art , how great Thou art; Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art

When through the woods and forest glades I wander and hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees; when I look down from lofty mountain grandeur and hear the brook, and feel the gentle breeze; Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art; Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

And when I think that God, His Son not sparing , sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in; that on the cross, my burden gladly bearing, He bled and died to take away my sin: Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

When Christ shall come with shout of acclamation and take me home, what joy shall fill my heart. Then I shall bow in humble adoration, and there proclaim: my God, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
occurrences.verse_text: How lovely on the Sabbath day; the heights of faith I climb, translated from the weekday cares to walk in realms sublime

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
occurrences.verse_text: The heart becomes an altar there; in Christ, God is not far. I sacrificed myself to Him with thoughts of Golgotha.

occurrences.hymn_title: How shall I sing that majesty?
occurrences.verse_text: How shall  I sing that majesty which angels do admire? Let dust in dust in silence lie; sing, sing, ye heavenly choir. Thousands of thousands stand around Thy  throne, O God most high;  ten thousand times ten thousand sound Thy praise; but who am I?

occurrences.hymn_title: How shall I sing that majesty?
occurrences.verse_text: Thy brightness unto them appears, while I Thy footsteps trace; a sound of God comes to my ears, but they behold Thy face: I shall, I fear, be dark and cold, with all my fire and light; yet when Thou dost accept their gold, Lord, treasure up my mite.

occurrences.hymn_title: How shall I sing that majesty?
occurrences.verse_text: Enlighten with faith's light my heart, inflame it with love's fire, then shall I sing and take my part with that celestial choir. They sing because Thou art their Sun; Lord, send a beam on me; for where heaven is but once begun, Thy place is everywhere.

occurrences.hymn_title: I sing the mighty power of God
occurrences.verse_text: I sing in mighty power of God that made the mountains rise, that spread the flowing seas abroad ,and built the lofty skies, I sing the wisdom that ordained the sun to rule the day; the moon shines full at His command and all the stars obey.

occurrences.hymn_title: I sing the mighty power of God
occurrences.verse_text: I sing the goodness of the Lord that filled the earth with food; He formed the creatures with His word and then pronounced them good. Lord, how Thy wonders are displayed wherever I turn my eye: If  I survey the ground I tread or gaze upon the sky!

I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You, I worship You, O prince of peace; that is what I want to do. I give you praise for You are my righteousness.  I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You.

O sanctified Sunday, the day of my Lord, what joy does Thy coming my spirit afford! The more when my eye the the dawn of day sees, I find myself blissful, revived and at ease. Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

Surely the presence of the Lord is in this place, I can feel His mighty power and His grace.  I can hear the brush of angels' wings, I see glory on each face, surely the presence of the Lord is in this place.

Give thanks with a grateful heart, give thanks to the Holy One, give thanks because He's given Jesus Christ His Son. And now let the weak say: "I am strong," let the poor say: "I am rich," because of what the Lord has done for us. And us. Give Thanks!

Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; There is no shadow of turning with Thee. Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou has been, Thou forever wilt be. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

Summer and winter and springtime and harvest, sun, moon, and stars in their courses above join with all nature in manifold witness to Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided: great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth, Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide; strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow, blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside! Great is thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Who will my soul to His will fashion? The Lord, who always cares for me. Who led with patience and compassion when counsel I decline? 'Twas He! Who gives me peace when conscience troubles; renews my spirit, sets me right, and who all joy and pleasure doubles? The arm of God reveals His might!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Should I not honour God the Father and not His kindness cast away? Should I not hearken and much rather go there where He directs my way? His will is in my heart remaining; His word gives strength each day anew. More love for Him my soul is gaining; may thus I love my neighbour too!

I sing praises to Your name, O Lord, praises to Your name, O Lord, for Your name is great and greatly to be praised. I sing praises to Your name, O Lord, praises to Your name, for Your name is great and greatly to praised.

I give glory to Your name, O Lord, praises to Your name, O Lord, for Your name is great and greatly to be praised. I sing praises to Your name, O Lord, praises to Your name, O Lord for Your name is great and praised.

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Lord, how can I ever praise You? Mighty God, Lord Sabbaoth! Give my of Your Spirits power that alone from You comes forth. Nothing will I do without You; always seek Your love and virtue. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.verse_text: Both in good days and in suffering, You O Lord, were ever true, Here's my soul to form and fashion, I submit my will to You. This my wish and earnest yearning to await, Lord, Your returning. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.verse_text: Father, You to me have rendered so much good each day anew. In Your sight I have found favour and a Friend in Jesus too. Guide me with Your gracious spirit to the goal, by Jesus merit. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

When morning gilds the skies, my heart, awaking cries: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised! Alike at work or prayer, on Him I cast my care: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!

Does sadness fill my mind? A solace here I find: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised Or fades my earthly bliss, comfort still is this: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!

The night becomes as day when from the heart I say: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised! The powers of darkness fear when these sweet words they hear: May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!
Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee; Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee, for Thy mighty power and love amaze me, amaze me; and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.

This is the glorious day of thanks.  Let all now thank the Lord, His praise resounding from our ranks, who can such gifts afford?  O bless this glorious day of joy, our hearts to Thee we raise, in songs of praise our tongues employ until the end of days.
All lands to God in joyful sounds aloft your voices raise. All honour bring, exalt His Name and glorious make His praise, and glorious make His praise.

Come, ye thankful people come, raise the song of harvest home; all is safely gathered in, ere the winter storms begin, God, our Father does provide for our needs to be supplied; come to God's own temple, come, raise the song of harvest home.

These to Thee, our God, we owe, source whence all our blessings flow; and for these our souls shall raise grateful vows and solemn praise. Come, then, thankful people, come, raise the song of harvest home; come to God's own temple, come, raise the song of harvest home.

Even so, Lord, quickly come to Thy final harvest home. Gather Thou Thy people in, free from sorrow, free from sin, there forever glorified in Thy presence to abide. Come with all Thine angels, come, raise the glorious harvest home.

Let all things now living a song of thanksgiving to God the Creator triumphantly raise, who fashioned and made us, protected and stayed us, who guides and leads to the end of our days. His banners are o'er us, His light goes before us, a pillar of fire shining forth in the night, till shadows have vanished and darkness is banished, as forward we travel from light into light.

His law He enforces; the stars in their courses and sun in its orbit obediently shine. The hills and the mountains, the rivers and fountains, deeps of the ocean proclaim Him divine. We too should be voicing our love and rejoicing; with glad adoration a song let us raise, till all things now living unite in thanksgiving: To God in the highest, hosanna and praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord! Over all our pain and suffering shines the Star of Hope, our Lord! To our Father's house we journey; steadfast, for God's strength we pray that above, the worlds confusion homeward, heavenward leads the way! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

Majesty, worship His majesty. Unto Jesus be glory, honour, and praise. Majesty kingdom authority flow from His throne unto His own; His anthems raise. So exalt  lift up on high the name of Jesus. Magnify, come glorify Christ Jesus, the King. Majesty, worship His majesty, Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all Kings.

Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art , how great Thou art; Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art

Worthy of reverence, worthy of awe, worthy of love and devotion; worthy of bowing and bending of knees, worthy of all this and added to these.. You are worthy, Father, Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer. You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.
Father, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth. Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name glorify Thy name in all the earth

Make us truly humble. Free from words ambition, serving Thee our firm decision. Make us pure of heart, Lord that we see clearly, truly seeking Thee sincerely. Let our hearts earth depart like an eagle soaring; Thee alone adoring.

occurrences.hymn_title: God of mercy, God of grace
occurrences.verse_text: Let the people praise You, Lord! Earth shall then her fruits afford, God to man His blessings give. All below and all above, one in joy and light and love, man to God devoted live.
God, the All merciful! Earth has forsaken Thy ways of blessedness, slighted Thy sword. Let now Thy grace in it's fullness awaken; give to us peace in our time, O Lord.
Let the day with You be ended as with You it has begun. And Your blessing, Lord, be granted till our days on earth are done. That at last Your children may keep eternal Sabbath day.

He is exalted, the King is exalted on high; I will praise Him. He is exalted, forever exalted, and I will praise His name! He is the Lord; forever His truth shall reign. Heaven and earth rejoice in His holy name. He is exalted, the King is exalted on high.
Holy, holy, holy!  Lord God Almighty! All Thy works shall praise Thee in earth and sky and sea. Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty, God in three persons, blessed Trinity.

occurrences.hymn_title: I sing the mighty power of God
occurrences.verse_text: I sing the goodness of the Lord that filled the earth with food; He formed the creatures with His word and then pronounced them good. Lord, how Thy wonders are displayed wherever I turn my eye: If  I survey the ground I tread or gaze upon the sky!

All Thy works with joy surround Thee, earth and heaven reflect Thy rays, stars and angels sing around Thee, centre of unbroken praise. Field and forest, vale and mountain, flowery meadow, flashing sea, chanting bird and flowing fountain call us to rejoice in Thee.

occurrences.hymn_title: O God, our help in ages past
occurrences.verse_text: Before the hills in order stood, or earth received her frame, from everlasting, Thou art God, to endless tears the same.

This is the glorious day of prayer.  Let earth to heaven draw near.  Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there, come down to meet us here.  O bless this glorious day of days, send forth Thy quickening breath and wake our souls to love and praise, O conqueror of death.

occurrences.hymn_title: We love the place, O God
occurrences.verse_text: We love Your altar, Lord; O what on earth so dear? For there, in faith adored, we find Your presence near. We love the word of life. The word that tells of peace, of comfort in the strife and joys that never cease. We love the place , O God, where in Your honour dwells; the joy of Your Abode all earthly joy excels.

occurrences.hymn_title: We love the place, O God
occurrences.verse_text: We love to sing below for mercies freely given; but Oh, we long to know the triumph song of heaven. Lord Jesus, give us grace on earth to love you more, in heaven to see Your face and with Your saints adore. We love the place , O God, where in Your honour dwells; the joy of Your abode all earthly joys excel.
Yes, all the earth shall worship Him, with joy to Him shall sing, and ever shall their joyful songs with loud hosannas ring, with loud hosannas ring.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: All people that on earth do dwell, sing to the Lord with cheerful voice. Him serve with joy, His praise forth tell. Come ye before Him and rejoice.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost, the God  whom heaven and earth adore, from earth and from the angel host be praise and glory evermore.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies, for the love which from our birth over and around us lies; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child, friends on earth and friends above, for all gentle thoughts and mild; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: Give to our God immortal praise
occurrences.verse_text: He built the earth, He spread the sky, and fixed the starry lights on high: Wonders of grace to God belong; repeat His mercies in your song.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Mighty God, we praise Thy name! All the earth must bow before Thee. We bring praise with loud acclaim, for Thy wondrous works adore Thee. As in ancient history, shalt Thou be eternally.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Holy Lord, God Sabbaoth! Lord of earth, of sea and heaven. Leader of the heavenly host, refuge safe and certain haven. Honour, praise to all made known; all is Thine and Thine alone!

Mighty the showers of blessing flowing throughout all the earth, bringing the time of refreshment, water for parched fields of dearth. Mighty, yes mighty the showers! Showers of glorious love, mercy and goodness abounding, blessings and joy from above!
Father, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth. Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name glorify Thy name in all the earth
Jesus, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth. Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name in all the earth.
Spirit, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth. Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name in all the earth.

occurrences.hymn_title: God of mercy, God of grace
occurrences.verse_text: Let the people praise You, Lord! Be by all that live, adored. Let the nations shout and sing, at Your feet their tribute pay and Your holy will obey; let the nations shout and sing!

occurrences.hymn_title: God of mercy, God of grace
occurrences.verse_text: Let the people praise You, Lord! Earth shall then her fruits afford, God to man His blessings give. All below and all above, one in joy and light and love, man to God devoted live.
Sunday, full of grace and glory, sweetest rest day of the soul! Here within a world of darkness do your blessings us console. Holy, happy, heavenly day, you can drive our grief away.
Let the day with You be ended as with You it has begun. And Your blessing, Lord, be granted till our days on earth are done. That at last Your children may keep eternal Sabbath day.

I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You, I worship You, O prince of peace; that is what I want to do. I give you praise for You are my righteousness.  I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You.

Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; There is no shadow of turning with Thee. Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou has been, Thou forever wilt be. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

Summer and winter and springtime and harvest, sun, moon, and stars in their courses above join with all nature in manifold witness to Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided: great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth, Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide; strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow, blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside! Great is thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

Majesty, worship His majesty. Unto Jesus be glory, honour, and praise. Majesty kingdom authority flow from His throne unto His own; His anthems raise. So exalt  lift up on high the name of Jesus. Magnify, come glorify Christ Jesus, the King. Majesty, worship His majesty, Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all Kings.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the fruits of all creation
occurrences.verse_text: For the fruits of all creation, thanks be to God. For His gifts to every nation, thanks be to God. For the plowing, sowing, reaping, silent growth while we are sleeping, future needs in earth's safe keeping, thanks be to God.

occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offer and unrest, praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled! Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art , how great Thou art; Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art

And when I think that God, His Son not sparing , sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in; that on the cross, my burden gladly bearing, He bled and died to take away my sin: Then sings my soul, my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art! Then sings my soul my saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art.

occurrences.verse_text: All people that on earth do dwell, sing to the Lord with cheerful voice. Him serve with joy, His praise forth tell. Come ye before Him and rejoice.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: O enter then His gates with praise; approach with joy His courts anew. Praise, laud   and bless His name always, for it is seemly so to do.

occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of ear and eye, for the heart and mind's delight, for the mystic harmony linking sense and sound to sight; Lord of all to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.verse_text: Who will my soul to His will fashion? The Lord, who always cares for me. Who led with patience and compassion when counsel I decline? 'Twas He! Who gives me peace when conscience troubles; renews my spirit, sets me right, and who all joy and pleasure doubles? The arm of God reveals His might!

occurrences.verse_text: Behold, my soul, the life eternal which God has planned for you to see. Surrounded by His heavenly glory, before His face you, too, shall be! occurrences.verse_text: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come; be Thou our Guide while life shall last, and our eternal home.

Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth, Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide; strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow, blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside! Great is thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord! Over all our pain and suffering shines the Star of Hope, our Lord! To our Father's house we journey; steadfast, for God's strength we pray that above, the worlds confusion homeward, heavenward leads the way! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
occurrences.verse_text: Rekindled by the spirits breath my fervour, courage flames and burns with wondrous hope and power, my love for God acclaims.

This is the glorious day of prayer.  Let earth to heaven draw near.  Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there, come down to meet us here.  O bless this glorious day of days, send forth Thy quickening breath and wake our souls to love and praise, O conqueror of death.

occurrences.hymn_title: How lovely on the Sabbath day

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Mighty God, we praise Thy name! All the earth must bow before Thee. We bring praise with loud acclaim, for Thy wondrous works adore Thee. As in ancient history, shalt Thou be eternally.

We lift our hearts before You and wait upon our word, we honour and adore You, our great and mighty Lord.

This is the glorious day of thanks.  Let all now thank the Lord, His praise resounding from our ranks, who can such gifts afford?  O bless this glorious day of joy, our hearts to Thee we raise, in songs of praise our tongues employ until the end of days.

Worthy of worship, worthy of praise, worthy of honour and glory; worthy of all the glad songs we can sing, worthy worthy of all the offerings we bring. You are worthy, Father Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer. You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.

occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offer and unrest, praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!

occurrences.verse_text: We love Your altar, Lord; O what on earth so dear? For there, in faith adored, we find Your presence near. We love the word of life. The word that tells of peace, of comfort in the strife and joys that never cease. We love the place , O God, where in Your honour dwells; the joy of Your Abode all earthly joy excels.

occurrences.verse_text: For why? The Lord our God is good; His mercy is forever sure. His truth at all times firmly stood, and shall from age to age endure.

occurrences.verse_text: The Lord, ye know, is God indeed; without our aid He did us make. We are His flock; He doth us feed, and for His sheep He doth us take.

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offer and unrest, praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!

Thou art giving and forgiving, ever blessing, ever blest, wellspring of the joy of living, ocean depth of happy rest! Thou our Father, Christ our brother all who live above are Thine; teach us how to love each other, lift us to the joy divine.

occurrences.hymn_title: O God, our help in ages past
occurrences.verse_text: Beneath the shadow of Thy throne, still may we dwell secure. Sufficient is Thine arm alone, and our defence is sure.
Beside us to guide us, our God with us joining, ordaining, maintaining His kingdom divine. So from the beginning the fight we were winning; Thou Lord, wast at our side and the glory be Thine!

Even so, Lord, quickly come to Thy final harvest home. Gather Thou Thy people in, free from sorrow, free from sin, there forever glorified in Thy presence to abide. Come with all Thine angels, come, raise the glorious harvest home.

Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth, Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide; strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow, blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside! Great is thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!
Great Father of glory and Father of light, Thine angels adore thee in Thy glorious sight. All praise we would render; O help us to see, for only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

occurrences.verse_text: Holy Lord, God Sabbaoth! Lord of earth, of sea and heaven. Leader of the heavenly host, refuge safe and certain haven. Honour, praise to all made known; all is Thine and Thine alone!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Have compassion, pity, Lord; with Thy blessing bring salvation. Goodness, love from me outpoured, give Thy promise confirmation. Never leave us, Lord alone, we would always be Thine own!

occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of each hour of the day and of the night, and for mountain, tree and flower, sun and moon and stars of light; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child, friends on earth and friends above, for all gentle thoughts and mild; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offer and unrest, praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled! Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in love for Christ our Lord! Love alone can drive out envy and dispute that breeds discord. Let our heartstrings be united, dedicated to the Lord, open to the Holy Spirit, to harmonious accord! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord! Over all our pain and suffering shines the Star of Hope, our Lord! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of each hour of the day and of the night, and for mountain, tree and flower, sun and moon and stars of light; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.verse_text: He fills the sun with morning light; he bids the moon direct the night: His mercies ever shall endure when sun and moon shall shine no more.

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Father, You to me have rendered so much good each day anew. In Your sight I have found favour and a Friend in Jesus too. Guide me with Your gracious spirit to the goal, by Jesus merit. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Father, at thy throne we bow, great and small, our honour bringing. And Thy congregation now praises to Thy Son is singing; praises to the Holy Ghost: Comfort, Guide and Royal Host!

occurrences.hymn_title: We love the place, O God
occurrences.verse_text: We love to sing below for mercies freely given; but Oh, we long to know the triumph song of heaven. Lord Jesus, give us grace on earth to love you more, in heaven to see Your face and with Your saints adore. We love the place , O God, where in Your honour dwells; the joy of Your abode all earthly joys excel.

occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart! Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart! occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in love for Christ our Lord! Love alone can drive out envy and dispute that breeds discord. Let our heartstrings be united, dedicated to the Lord, open to the Holy Spirit, to harmonious accord! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned!

occurrences.hymn_title: Give to our God immortal praise
occurrences.verse_text: Through this vain world He guides our feet and leads us to His heavenly seat: His mercies ever shall endure when this vain world shall be no more.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: For why? The Lord our God is good; His mercy is forever sure. His truth at all times firmly stood, and shall from age to age endure.

occurrences.hymn_title: All people that on earth do dwell
occurrences.verse_text: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost, the God  whom heaven and earth adore, from earth and from the angel host be praise and glory evermore.

occurrences.verse_text: In the just reward of labour, God's will is done. In the help we give our neighbours, God's will be done. In our worldwide task of caring for the hungry and despairing, in the harvests we are sharing, Gods will is done.

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: How great is God's almighty kindness! Who by His love would not be moved? Who in this world could be so mindless to spurn the love that God has proved? His love so great to keep and measure, my holy duty it shall be. The Lord gave me a precious treasure; fail not, my soul, to thankful be!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord! Over all our pain and suffering shines the Star of Hope, our Lord! To our Father's house we journey; steadfast, for God's strength we pray that above, the worlds confusion homeward, heavenward leads the way! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

Mighty the showers of blessing! Hark! From afar They resound, and in the midst of God's children blessing abundant is found. Mighty, yes, mighty the showers! Showers of glorious love, mercy and goodness abounding, blessings and joy from above!

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies, for the love which from our birth over and around us lies; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the beauty of each hour of the day and of the night, and for mountain, tree and flower, sun and moon and stars of light; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of ear and eye, for the heart and mind's delight, for the mystic harmony linking sense and sound to sight; Lord of all to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child, friends on earth and friends above, for all gentle thoughts and mild; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the beauty of the earth
occurrences.verse_text: For Thy church that evermore lifteth holy hands above, offering up on every shore her pure sacrifice of love; Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: For the fruits of all creation
occurrences.verse_text: For the harvests of the spirit, thanks be to God. For the good we all inherit, thanks be to God. For the wonders that astound us, for the truths that still confound us, most of all, that love has found us, thanks be to God.

Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; There is no shadow of turning with Thee. Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou has been, Thou forever wilt be. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

Summer and winter and springtime and harvest, sun, moon, and stars in their courses above join with all nature in manifold witness to Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love. Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see. All I have needed Thy hand hath provided: great is Thy faithfulness, Lord unto me!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: How great is God's almighty kindness! Who by His love would not be moved? Who in this world could be so mindless to spurn the love that God has proved? His love so great to keep and measure, my holy duty it shall be. The Lord gave me a precious treasure; fail not, my soul, to thankful be!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Should I not honour God the Father and not His kindness cast away? Should I not hearken and much rather go there where He directs my way? His will is in my heart remaining; His word gives strength each day anew. More love for Him my soul is gaining; may thus I love my neighbour too!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Who will my soul to His will fashion? The Lord, who always cares for me. Who led with patience and compassion when counsel I decline? 'Twas He! Who gives me peace when conscience troubles; renews my spirit, sets me right, and who all joy and pleasure doubles? The arm of God reveals His might!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord! Over all our pain and suffering shines the Star of Hope, our Lord! To our Father's house we journey; steadfast, for God's strength we pray that above, the worlds confusion homeward, heavenward leads the way! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise! Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Both in good days and in suffering, You O Lord, were ever true, Here's my soul to form and fashion, I submit my will to You. This my wish and earnest yearning to await, Lord, Your returning. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Behold, my soul, the life eternal which God has planned for you to see. Surrounded by His heavenly glory, before His face you, too, shall be! This joy, by right, you may be sharing which God in goodness grant to you. The suffering which His Son was bearing; wrought that you share His glory too!

occurrences.hymn_title: How great is God's almighty kindness
occurrences.verse_text: Should I not honour God the Father and not His kindness cast away? Should I not hearken and much rather go there where He directs my way? His will is in my heart remaining; His word gives strength each day anew. More love for Him my soul is gaining; may thus I love my neighbour too!

His law He enforces; the stars in their courses and sun in its orbit obediently shine. The hills and the mountains, the rivers and fountains, deeps of the ocean proclaim Him divine. We too should be voicing our love and rejoicing; with glad adoration a song let us raise, till all things now living unite in thanksgiving: To God in the highest, hosanna and praise.

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Father, You to me have rendered so much good each day anew. In Your sight I have found favour and a Friend in Jesus too. Guide me with Your gracious spirit to the goal, by Jesus merit. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

His banners are o'er us, His light goes before us, a pillar of fire shining forth in the night, till shadows have vanished and darkness is banished, as forward we travel from light into light.

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: The apostles at Thy throne offer thanks and adoration. Envoys these, Thy very own, join in hymns of exaltation. All thy children Thee adore, laud and praise Thee evermore!

occurrences.hymn_title: Let us sing with joyful voices
occurrences.verse_text: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in love for Christ our Lord! Love alone can drive out envy and dispute that breeds discord. Let our heartstrings be united, dedicated to the Lord, open to the Holy Spirit, to harmonious accord! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned! Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Holy Lord, God Sabbaoth! Lord of earth, of sea and heaven. Leader of the heavenly host, refuge safe and certain haven. Honour, praise to all made known; all is Thine and Thine alone!

occurrences.hymn_title: Lord, How can I ever praise You?
occurrences.verse_text: Both in good days and in suffering, You O Lord, were ever true, Here's my soul to form and fashion, I submit my will to You. This my wish and earnest yearning to await, Lord, Your returning. Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

occurrences.hymn_title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
occurrences.verse_text: Mighty God, we praise Thy name! All the earth must bow before Thee. We bring praise with loud acclaim, for Thy wondrous works adore Thee. As in ancient history, shalt Thou be eternally.
